title: TUT Master Template — Company Config Schema
description: Validation schema for company JSON configs. Used by validateConfig() in main.js at runtime.

configVersion.description: Schema version. Increment major on breaking shape changes. Used by migrateConfig().

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this config was first generated by AI or manually.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this config was last modified.

checksum.description: FNV-1a hash of the config JSON content. Used to detect manual edits after AI generation. Generated by the config generator, not the renderer.

status.description: Controls demo visibility. draft = preview banner shown. archived = offline screen shown. published = normal render.

locale.description: UI language for WhatsApp messages, button labels, form placeholders. Does not affect company content fields.

lockedFields.description: Dot-notation field paths that AI regeneration must not overwrite. Example: ['hero.headline', 'services']

meta.description: SEO and social sharing metadata. Injected into <head> by applyMeta().

ogImage.description: Absolute URL or relative path to OG/Twitter preview image. Should be 1200x630px.

defaultOgImage.description: Template-level OG image fallback used when ogImage is absent.

brand.description: Brand identity. name and accent are required.

name.description: Company display name. Used in headings, footer, WhatsApp messages.

tagline.description: Short tagline shown in hero eyeline.

logo.description: Logo image path or URL. Empty string = text logo fallback.

industry.description: Industry classification. Drives fallback hero gradient and future theme variations.

accent.description: Primary brand color. Used for buttons, highlights, accents.

accentAlt.description: Hover/gradient variant. Usually a lighter shade of accent.

hero.description: Hero section content. headline and subheadline are required.

bgImage.description: Hero background image path or URL. Falls back to industry gradient on error.

bgVideo.description: Hero background video path. Takes priority over bgImage if set.

badges.description: Stat badges shown at the bottom of the hero.

heading.description: Section heading. Use \n for a line break.

body.description: Body paragraphs. Can be a single string or array of strings.

image.description: About section image path or URL.

director.description: Director/founder quote card. Set to null to hide.

contact.description: Contact information. whatsapp is required — all WhatsApp CTAs derive from it.

phone.description: Display phone number including country code.

whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number — digits only, no +, no spaces. Tanzania: 255XXXXXXXXX

mapEmbed.description: Google Maps embed src URL only (not the full iframe tag).

social.description: Social media profile URLs. Empty string = hidden.

internal.description: CRM and operational metadata. NEVER rendered publicly. Used by dashboard and generation pipeline.

leadId.description: Unique lead ID from the CRM system.

createdAt.description: When the lead was first identified.

updatedAt.description: When the lead record was last updated.

source.description: Lead source. Example: nest-awarded-tenders, manual, referral.

salesRep.description: Username of the sales rep who owns this lead.

demoVersion.description: Template version used when this demo was generated.

outreachStatus.description: Current state of the outreach process for this lead.

_dataSourceHint.description: Future: per-field source/confidence metadata for AI-enriched data. Shape: { fieldPath: { value, source, confidence } }

visibleSection.description: Reusable shape for all optional array sections.

visible.description: If false, the section is hidden regardless of items content.

items.description: Section content. Empty array auto-hides the section even if visible is true.
